title.narrative: Supporting the Institutional Capacity of the National Coordination and Joint Risk Analysis Centre (NACORAC)

description.narrative: The Overall Objective of the Action is to support progress on alignment with EU acquis and improve Turkey's institutional capacity on integrated border management (IBM) as regards Chapter 24 (Justice, Freedom and Security). The Specific Objective is to improve inter-service cooperation on IBM through support to the institutional capacity and the operationalisation of NACORAC in line with EU standards.
